name: Explore the academic portfolio and filter publications
description: Verifies the core portfolio navigation and publication discovery experience.
steps: Use the navigation to open Publications
expected: The page navigates to the selected section and the publication list updates to match the search and year filter.

name: Switch theme and use mobile navigation
description: Verifies theme switching and navigation on a mobile viewport.
steps: Open the site at a mobile viewport
Switch between light and dark themes
expected: Research is brought into view, the mobile menu closes, and the selected theme is visibly applied.

name: Validate the collaboration contact form
description: Verifies required fields and that the contact flow does not falsely claim a message was sent.
steps: Submit the form with required fields empty
Enter valid name, email, subject, and message
expected: Required-field validation is shown for incomplete input; a completed form opens the user's email application with a prepared message and explains the handoff.

name: Use publication filters with no matching results
description: Verifies that an unmatched search shows a helpful empty state and can be cleared.
steps: Search for a deliberately unmatched phrase
expected: A clear no-results message appears, and clearing the search restores the available publication-state information.

name: Open verified external academic profiles
description: Verifies the profile section provides direct external links to the five scholarly and professional resources.
steps: Navigate to the Academic Profile section
Check that Google Scholar, ResearchGate, LinkedIn, African Academy of Sciences, and AD Scientific Index links are visible
expected: All five profile links are visible and each points to the corresponding external profile.
